meta.title: Submitting a regret-only draft (no prices) in a one-round event
gaps: The available operations cannot mark the draft line as regretted before submission, so the plan submits an unpriced draft rather than an exact regret-only draft.
The plan does not verify the alternative accepted outcome in which the bid immediately changes to revised.
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The invited QA vendor submits the bid with the status set to “active”.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
